x-aisa-source.public_path_mapping: Reviewed AIsa routing maps the account-specific Cloudsway endpoint to /apis/v1/search/smart.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The user's search query term, which cannot be empty.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of search results to return. Defaults to 10, maximum 50. Enumerated values: 10 / 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 The actual number returned may be less than requested. Use this parameter with the offset parameter for pagination.

parameters.name: freshness
parameters.description: Filter search results by time range: - Day (past 24 hours) -Week (past 7 days) - Month (past 30 days)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The zero-based offset indicating how many results to skip before returning. Defaults to 0. Use with the count parameter for pagination. There is no upper limit for offset; setting a large value may result in no results being returned.

parameters.name: enableContent
parameters.description: ontrols whether to return long abstract content: -true: Return long abstracts -false: Do not return long abstracts Defaults to false

parameters.name: contentType
parameters.description: The format of the long abstract (content) to return. Options:：- HTML- MARKDOWN- TEXT(default)

parameters.name: contentTimeout
parameters.description: Timeout for reading long abstracts. If reading exceeds this time, it will terminate and no long abstract will be returned for that result. Defaults to 0 (seconds), maximum 10s.

parameters.name: mainText
parameters.description: Controls whether to return key fragments of dynamic abstracts:true： Return key fragmentsfalse：Do not return key fragmentsDefault false

parameters.name: sites
parameters.description: The value must be in host address format (e.g., baijiahao.baidu.com). Returns results only from the specified site(s).

parameters.name: blockWebsites
parameters.description: The value must be in host address format (e.g., baijiahao.baidu.com). Excludes results from the specified site(s).

parameters.name: Pragma
parameters.description: Input value: no-cache. When no-cache is provided, the response results will not be cached and each request is independent; if not provided, the response results for the same query term will be cached for 10 minutes

200.description: Official typed response table; required fields and undeclared array item types are not inferred.

datePublished.description: Page publication time (included in some sites) Example: 2025-07-14T01:15:00.0000000Z

snippet.description: Text snippet describing the webpage content

mainText.description: Dynamic abstract fragment extracted from the text, most relevant to the query. More intelligent than snippet

contentCrawled.description: Long abstract retrieval status: true for success (content is included in content), false for failure (content is empty)

content.description: Long abstract information of the webpage, retrieved from the main text. MARKDOWN and HTML formats include image links with anchor positions

imageList.description: List of image URLs in the webpage (included in some webpages, depending on whether the page contains images)
